domainObjects.definition: Reusable SOP, checklist, inspection, approval, or incident-response template.
Ordered executable step with required evidence, exception policy, optional form field binding, and escalation metadata.
Location, role, or person assignment rule that can later generate recurring runs.
Executable workflow occurrence with due window, assignee, status, and review state.
Per-step execution state with evidence status, notes, failed reason, and exception status.
Attachment, signature, scan, rating, reading, note, or structured value captured during execution.
Manager approval/rejection record for runs requiring review.
Failed, missed, unsafe, or out-of-standard condition that must be owned and resolved.

reuseMap.workflowUse: Builder field schema and evidence capture primitives.
reuseMap.decision: Reuse forms/form_fields for complex input controls; workflows own scheduling, execution, review, and exceptions.

reuseMap.workflowUse: Follow-up work, exceptions, and automation outcomes.
reuseMap.decision: Reuse tasks for work ownership; do not use tasks as checklist templates.

reuseMap.workflowUse: Operational issue stream and AI automation suggestions.
reuseMap.decision: Reuse ops_issues for incident/exception visibility, with workflow_exceptions linking back to root execution evidence.

reuseMap.workflowUse: Immutable manager actions, approval decisions, automation hooks, and compliance exports.
reuseMap.decision: Keep audit_log as the system audit destination; workflow tables carry operational state.

tenantRules: Every workflow-owned row must carry company_id.
Workflow child rows inherit company_id from workflow, run, step, or step run triggers.
Every workflow table must have RLS enabled and filter by current_user_company_ids().
Forms and tasks can be linked only when they belong to the same company_id.
permissionRules: Owners and admins can manage templates, assignments, compliance packs, and review policy.
Managers can launch runs, review exceptions, and approve or reject runs.
Employees can execute assigned runs and upload required evidence.
Automated workflow actions must create tasks/issues through audited service routes.
